transcript.text: This is Swift, an automated flood assistant working with local emergency services. Am I speaking with someone at 312 Great Glen Drive?
Yes, this is 312 Great Glen Drive. I’m alone and the water’s not in yet. I can help with a truck.
Got it, 312 Great Glen Drive, water not in yet. How many people are at the home right now, including anyone who can't come to the phone?
One person is here. No one can’t come to the phone.

Got it, one person here, no one can’t come to the phone. Is there anyone there who can't leave on their own, for example someone who uses a wheelchair, needs oxygen, or is bedbound? If it's a wheelchair, does it have a motor?
No one can’t leave alone. No wheelchair or medical needs here.
Understood, no one is unable to leave alone. Is there water inside the home right now?
No water inside. I can help—truck is available.
Thanks for your help and availability. If neighbors need a ride out, do you have a high-clearance truck, a boat, or free seats in a vehicle?
I have a high-clearance truck available. No free seats in a vehicle.
Got it, high-clearance truck available. Let me read that back: 1 people; no water inside yet; you can help with a truck. Is that right?
Yes. One person. No water inside. I can help with a truck.

Thank you for confirming and offering to help with a truck. I've recorded that you may be able to help neighbors. A dispatcher may contact you. Only go out if it's safe for you, and never drive into water you can't see the bottom of. Goodbye.
